scope: Focused offline phase checks with small fixtures; no Unity, visual acceptance or movement tuning.

checks.name: Bridge support waits for construction, including a saved midpoint
In-flight cargo cannot be picked up; identity and remaining duration survive restore
Phase snapshots do not expose mutable construction or cargo state
Horizontal motion respects the authored ceiling and permits escape from an initial overlap
Cargo clearance uses actual roof geometry instead of the lowroof metadata rectangle
Airborne motion cannot enter an ascending solid slope and one-way platforms remain passable
